title: Inter Extend Carlos Augusto to 2031 — Bastoni Has Scans Before Genoa | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Inter were right to keep Carlos Augusto — he is signed until 2031, and Bastoni's scans today will show how serious his thigh is.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=87

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Carlos Augusto extends his Inter contract until June 30, 2031 (Inter.it, Nov 26).
CONFIRMED — Dortmund away tickets on sale: €18.50, standing only, one per person (Inter.it, Nov 26).
REPORTED — Bastoni has scans today on a sore quadriceps; his place against Genoa is still open (La Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews, Nov 26).
REPORTED — Zieliński and Bonny again trained apart; Çalhanoğlu targets the Super Cup on December 22 (FCInterNews, Nov 26).
NEXT — Inter vs Genoa, Sat, Nov 28, 2:45 PM ET, 20:45 CET, Serie A matchday 13. US TV: Paramount+.
